system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Agent has two native tools — `memory_search` and `memory_save`; relevant recall is auto-injected each turn.
system_prompt_style.note: Caveman Mode levels and per-turn memory recall suggest runtime composition; no prompt builder code in evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Repo map plus read/grep/find/ls navigation tools; whether the repo map is injected by default is not shown.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Per-tool line caps (bash 80 · read 300 · grep 120), ANSI strip, blank-line collapse, semantic JSON/XML extraction.
context_compaction.note: summarize is inferred from the /compact manual compaction command and packages/ai/src/cache/compaction.ts; its mechanism is not shown in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Tool output | Tool Budgets | Per-tool line caps (bash 80 · read 300 · grep 120)
observation_format.note: The test file image-tool-result.test.ts hints at image results, but this is unverified.

tool_call_format.note: The parser is not shown; the value is inferred from provider adapters.

tool_count.note: Tools named across the docs include Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write, Task, memory_search and memory_save. The default count is not stated.

edit_primitive.note: search_replace is inferred from apply-sr-diff.ts. ast_aware is inferred from edit-symbol.ts. The README also lists edit-format-per-model.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP transports: stdio · Streamable HTTP · in-process. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE; tokens in OS keychain.
tool_schema_source.note: The source of the built-in tool schemas is not shown; packages/ai/src/utils/typebox-helpers.ts suggests they may be auto-generated.

protocol_standardization.note: The mcp value rests on the MCP client and server. The other value is ACP, inferred from the file name acp.ts.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Ralph-style autopilot. Rolling state, per-iteration $/token ledger, shadow-git checkpoints, ranked termination
loop_primitives.note: react is the default loop. The goal loop, plan mode (/plan then /act) and the event API are opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Model sees only `read`/`grep`/`find`/`ls`, produces a written plan, never edits.
planning_granularity.note: Plan mode is opt-in. /act executes a saved plan, which could qualify as explicit_plan_object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Subagents** — up to 7 parallel, worktree-isolated. Frontmatter agents at `.cave/agents/*.md` (Claude Code superset). Five ship by default.
multi_agent_topology.note: The Task tool appears to be available by default.

human_in_loop.note: Autopilot mode runs without permission prompts.

short_term_state.note: This applies to the goal loop; plain sessions store JSONL.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Persistent memory delegated to [cavemem](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/cavemem) (MIT, hybrid BM25 + local vectors).
long_term_memory.note: skill_library comes from ~/.cave/skills. file_notes comes from the MEMORY.md sync.

self_verification.note: The shipped critic, reviewer and tester agents and packages/agent/src/localizer/verifier.ts exist, but harness enforcement is not shown.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: ranked termination (sentinel · iteration cap · $-cap · no-progress · SIGINT)
termination_condition.note: These termination conditions belong to the goal loop; the default chat ends when the model stops calling tools.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Architect / editor split** — slow model plans, fast model executes.
cost_controls.note: token_budget is the goal loop's $-cap. caching comes from CAVE_CACHE_RETENTION. model_routing comes from router.ts and the architect/editor split.

timeouts.note: The quoted timeout is for a hook, not a tool, so evidence is weak.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Optional external Rust binary ("Rust Token Killer") — pipes bash output through `rtk` before it enters context.
execution_isolation.note: Inferred from bash execution on the host terminal agent; subagents are worktree-isolated and prompts can be dispatched to a remote `caveman worker` (opt-in). No sandbox/container described.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: macOS Seatbelt, Linux Landlock, Windows Restricted Tokens. Permission modes cycle on Shift+Tab.

tracing.evidence_quote: JSONL sessions in `~/.cave/agent/sessions/`, organized by working directory.

replayability.evidence_quote: Replay functionality is planned for future releases.
replayability.note: Sessions can be resumed or forked, and packages/agent/src/cost/replay.ts exists.

eval_hooks.note: The swe-bench and terminal-bench runners live in packages/agent/src/bench.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Non-zero exit denies the write and tells the model why.
guardrails.note: The README states that hooks never block, which contradicts the cookbook.

target_domain.evidence_quote: The terminal coding agent that talks like a caveman

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Frozen — terminal coding agent measured at 1.93× fewer tokens than Codex CLI.
